meaning: Temperature sensor error: LG says tE can appear because of a temperature sensor contact problem or a sensor failure.
causes: A temperature sensor contact problem or a sensor failure, the causes LG gives
diySteps: LG gives no homeowner fix for tE: it says the error requires inspection by a service technician
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: LG does not publish a reset for dishwasher tE. Not the same as LG dishwasher HE, which allows one power-off and a 10-second breaker reset before service. Not the same as LG washer tE, which is a heating error (usually a faulty thermistor) with an unplug, drain and restart sequence on the washer page.
sourceTitle: [LG Dishwasher] Guide to Error Codes (LG USA Support)
